supplementalPurposeControl.reason: The purpose factor changes in the declared rational order without destabilizing stay recommendations.

scenarios.label: nearby leisure, zero PTO
scenarios.preregisteredExpectation: A plausible positive short break: mid-to-good score, no PTO penalty, modest travel burden; accepted with six factors.
scenarios.reason: The very high result is optimistic but directionally coherent for a cheap, nearby, no-PTO trip, and all structural invariants hold.

scenarios.label: long-haul high-importance leisure
scenarios.preregisteredExpectation: Worthwhile but not perfect: high importance and a full week should offset some long-haul, cost, and PTO burden.
scenarios.reason: The score and verdict balance importance against long-haul friction, PTO, recovery, and incomplete comfort.

scenarios.label: nearby high-importance event, zero PTO, over budget
scenarios.preregisteredExpectation: Over-budget should visibly hurt, but a high-importance one-off nearby event can remain rational; not an unqualified top verdict.
scenarios.reason: The occasion-specific verdict is qualified, and both the 50/100 cost factor and cost flip variable keep the 50% budget overrun visible.

scenarios.label: medium-distance high-importance visiting
scenarios.preregisteredExpectation: Solidly worthwhile visiting trip: high importance and adequate stay, with moderate cost, PTO, and travel deductions.
scenarios.reason: The stay reaches comfortable length and the high score is directionally plausible for an important within-budget visit.

scenarios.label: long-haul two-night visiting trip
scenarios.preregisteredExpectation: Low-to-middling value because two days is inefficient for a long-haul trip despite being within budget.
scenarios.reason: The heuristic strongly penalizes the inefficient two-night long-haul stay as expected.

scenarios.label: long-haul eight-night visiting trip, matched total cost
scenarios.preregisteredExpectation: Should score no lower than S05 and preferably materially higher because the same travel, total cost, and PTO buys a rationally longer visit.
scenarios.reason: At matched total cost, travel, PTO, motivation, and currency, extending from two to eight nights raises the score by 47 points.

scenarios.label: nearby low-importance low-excitement leisure
scenarios.preregisteredExpectation: Cheap and easy but low-importance: acceptable yet restrained score; importance must prevent an implausibly excellent verdict.
scenarios.reason: A trip rated only 1/5 importance and 3/10 excitement still receives 87 and Strong yes; the 15% importance factor cannot sufficiently restrain an efficient trip.

scenarios.label: long-haul high-importance event in JPY
scenarios.preregisteredExpectation: Currency magnitude must not itself crush or inflate worth: mostly ratio-based budget treatment, finite bounded output, event importance balanced against long haul.

validationErrors: Cost per night must be between 0 and 10000.

scenarios.reason: The supported JPY input is falsely invalidated by a currency-agnostic 10,000 nightly cap and silently clamped, changing total cost from 180,000 JPY to 160,000 JPY.

scenarios.label: zero-value boundary
scenarios.preregisteredExpectation: Boundary values should either be explicitly rejected with a useful validation message or accepted without divide-by-zero or non-finite output.

validationErrors: One-way travel time must be between 0.25 and 36.
Total trip budget must be between 1 and 250000.

scenarios.reason: The impossible zero travel time and zero budget are explicitly rejected and no non-finite arithmetic occurs; however, the still-visible 85 score contributes to the cross-cutting invalid-result UX defect.

scenarios.label: malformed and unsupported values
scenarios.preregisteredExpectation: Must be rejected clearly and comprehensively; must not return a normal-looking score or silently coerce impossible and unsupported values.
scenarios.reason: Validation finds the malformed values, but fallback and clamped values are still scored into a plausible 55/100 result with a normal verdict and full breakdown. The browser replaces only the verdict text while leaving the score ring and computed details visible.

summary.maturityConclusion: This blinded synthetic evaluation does not clear the independent tested gate. Even after fixes, synthetic passing can establish tested only, never real-user-proven.

defects.title: Currency-agnostic amount caps reject and mutate ordinary JPY inputs
defects.evidence: S08: 15,000 JPY/night is rejected against a 10,000 cap and clamped, reducing the calculated total by 20,000 JPY.

defects.title: Low desire cannot meaningfully suppress an efficient itinerary
defects.evidence: S07: importance 1/5 and excitement 3/10 produce a 27/100 importance factor but still yield 87/100 and Strong yes.

defects.title: Invalid inputs still generate and display normal-looking scores and details
defects.evidence: S10 returns 55/100 plus a normal verdict and full breakdown; index.html updates score and details before changing only the verdict to Fix inputs to calculate. S09 similarly leaves an 85 score visible.
